books.title: Zareen’s Pakistani Kitchen: Recipes from a Well-Fed Childhood (Pakistani and Indian Cooking)
books.author: Zareen Khan (Author), Umair Khan (Author)
books.description:
Replete with stunning photography and heartfelt stories, Zareen’s Pakistani Kitchen celebrates the rich, diverse flavors of Pakistani cuisine—along with beloved Desi dishes from across the Indian subcontinent.

Created by the team behind the James Beard semifinalist–approved restaurant Zareen's in the San Francisco Bay Area, this cookbook makes authentic Pakistani, Indian, and South Asian recipes simple, approachable, and deeply satisfying for home cooks everywhere.

Inside, you’ll find 95 flavorful recipes designed for American kitchens, blending favorites from Zareen’s restaurants, nostalgic family dishes, and vibrant street food from Karachi.
